TABLE.NAME: tool_upgradeguard_scan
TABLE.COMMENT: One record per Upgrade Guard scan.

FIELD.NAME: currentversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle release of the site that was scanned

FIELD.NAME: currentbranch
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle branch of the site that was scanned, eg 502

FIELD.NAME: phpversion
FIELD.COMMENT: PHP version the scan was queued with, eg 8.3.30

FIELD.NAME: dbvendor
FIELD.COMMENT: Database vendor of the site, eg mysql, mariadb or postgres

FIELD.NAME: dbversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Version of the database server, eg 8.4.3

FIELD.NAME: phpextensions
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of the loaded PHP extensions when the scan was queued

FIELD.NAME: targetversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle version the scan was run against, eg 5.2

FIELD.NAME: targetbranch
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle branch that was scanned against, eg 502

FIELD.NAME: datasetversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Version of the rule dataset used by the scan

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, running, finished or failed

FIELD.NAME: stage
FIELD.COMMENT: Language string key of the stage the scan is in

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: Progress of the scan, 0 to 100

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Readiness score, 0 to 100

FIELD.NAME: verdict
FIELD.COMMENT: go, careful or stop

FIELD.NAME: environmentblockercount
FIELD.COMMENT: Site-wide environment blockers found by the scan

FIELD.NAME: environmentcautioncount
FIELD.COMMENT: Site-wide environment cautions found by the scan

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Friendly message shown when the scan failed

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The administrator who started the scan

TABLE.NAME: tool_upgradeguard_plugin
TABLE.COMMENT: One record per plugin found by a scan.

FIELD.NAME: scanid
FIELD.COMMENT: The scan this plugin was found in

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle component name, eg mod_forum

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin name within its type, eg forum

FIELD.NAME: pluginrelease
FIELD.COMMENT: Declared release of the plugin on disk

FIELD.NAME: versionrequires
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum Moodle version declared by the plugin

FIELD.NAME: supportedlist
FIELD.COMMENT: Branches declared in plugin->supported, eg 404-502

FIELD.NAME: incompatiblebranch
FIELD.COMMENT: First branch the plugin declares itself incompatible with

FIELD.NAME: currentpath
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative path the plugin is stored in right now

FIELD.NAME: newpath
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative path the plugin has to live in after the upgrade

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: ready, update, caution, blocker or unknown

FIELD.NAME: usagecount
FIELD.COMMENT: How many places on the site use the plugin, null when unknown

FIELD.NAME: usagedetail
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON with the breakdown of the usage count

TABLE.NAME: tool_upgradeguard_finding
TABLE.COMMENT: One record per finding produced by a scan.

FIELD.NAME: pluginid
FIELD.COMMENT: tool_upgradeguard_plugin id, 0 for site wide findings

FIELD.NAME: checkkey
FIELD.COMMENT: The check that produced this finding

FIELD.NAME: severity
FIELD.COMMENT: blocker, caution or info

FIELD.NAME: messagekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Language string key of the message shown to the admin

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON with the parameters of the message

FIELD.NAME: confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: low, medium or high

FIELD.NAME: fixedbyupdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether updating the plugin is expected to fix it

FIELD.NAME: actionkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Language string key of the suggested action
